verdict.rationale: Attio's own docs show it supports custom fields and data modeling ("Customize fields to capture exactly what you need to track", custom objects with many attribute types) and offers table and kanban views of data. However, the only filter and sort evidence covers REST API request parameters, which is a developer building block, not user-built views. There is no evidence of sharing views or that non-admin ops users can do this themselves; Deal object activation is explicitly admin-only. missing for 10: UI-level filtered/sorted saved views, shared views, evidence that non-admin users can add fields and views, independent or hands-on corroboration
